== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Tartarus]] [[Incarnation]], also known as [[Incarnation|the Incarnation]] of [[Tartarus]], is a ten-foot-tall metallic [[giant]] clad in gleaming mirrored [[steel]] armor. Characterized by a voice resembling grinding stones and eyes made of blank metal gears, the entity possesses immense physical strength and an unstoppable momentum that allows it to push against multiple [[Nye]] simultaneously. In combat, the creature can manifest seemingly endless metal shards from its grip to impale enemies and uses a clockwork gaze to pin targets. Despite being broken into pieces, the entity can be reconstructed at the will of [[King Zakareth VI|King Zakareth]]. While it has demonstrated a capacity for [[destruction]], such as shattering doors and frames, its obedience appears limited; it may struggle to understand commands or act with the petty spite of a child when following orders. [[Incarnation|The Incarnation]] has previously fought against certain individuals under specific restrictions and can be directed by those representing the [[Incarnation of Ragnarus]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|This ten-foot titan is clad in [[steel]] armor. Its eyes are composed of blank metal gears.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|After being defeated in battle, the [[Tartarus]] [[Incarnation]] managed to escape. This ten-foot titan is characterized by its [[steel]] armor and eyes composed of blank metal gears. While within the [[House of Blades]], the entity began the process of pulling itself back together. Ultimately, the incarnation met its end when [[Mithra]] passed through its neck to secure a final defeat.}}
